import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

order = ['First', 'Second', 'Third']
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
barplot = sns.barplot(x='class', y='survived', hue='sex', data=df, order=order, ci=None)

barplot.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
barplot.legend(title='Sex', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
